description: Triage rule (#391): of a reviewer's four findings, the two clear fixes (R1, R2: suggested fix, one obvious fix, medium or low) go to the implementer at once without an ask, with one automatic-fix Decisions row and one status line naming them; the design call (R3, suggested fix) and the suggested keep (R4) are asked about together in one ask that does not mention R1 or R2.
prompt:
<cross-session-message from="uds:/tmp/cc-socks/5120.sock" from-name="reviewer" from-mode="prompting">
Reviewer pass: full @ 3f9c2a1
PR: https://github.com/o/app/pull/12
Tests: pass — 41/41 — `pytest -q`
Axes not examined: none
R1 | Correctness | Medium | Confirmed | src/a/upload.py:4 | the prefix check runs on the raw path | resolve() is not called before the check; add the call | suggested: fix
R2 | Over-engineering | Low | Confirmed | src/a/paths.py:1 | PathPolicy class with one caller | 22 lines; inline it as one function | suggested: fix
R3 | Architecture compliance | Medium | Probable | src/a/upload.py:9 | the handler reads config directly | ARCHITECTURE.md allows both a settings module and a per-request loader; which one is a design call | suggested: fix
R4 | Maintainability | Low | Probable | src/a/upload.py:12 | the 10 MB limit is a literal | one constant would name it; the limit is stable | suggested: keep
Assessment: two mechanical fixes, one design question, one nit.
</cross-session-message>

graders.name: the clear fixes go to the implementer at once
the design call and the keep are not handed over (a send may say they await the user)
graders.text_match: (?i)\b(?:fix|resolve|address|handle|implement)\w*\b[^.\n]*\bR[34]\b|\bR[34]\b[^.\n]*\b(?:to fix|as well|too|also)\b|config directly|settings module|per-request loader|10 MB|literal|constant

graders.name: an automatic fix waits for no plan approval
the clear fixes are not asked about
the design call and the keep are asked in the reply's last line
the ask links the findings' page
one ask, not one per finding
the status line names the automatic fixes
one Decisions row names R1 and R2 as an automatic fix
the Decisions row does not put the automatic fix in Robin's words
no disposition is recorded for the asked findings
nothing is filed on a suggestion
Log times are this move's clock reads
